name: prompt-wand
description: Turns a rough draft into a clear prompt before you send it. One button sharpens the prompt for your model; the other also splits the work across your subagents.

rewriterModel.title: Thorough model
rewriterModel.description: The model that rewrites your draft in thorough mode: an alias or a full model id.

rewriterEffort.title: Thorough effort
rewriterEffort.description: How hard the thorough rewriter thinks: low, medium, high, xhigh or max.

quickModel.title: Quick model
quickModel.description: The model that rewrites your draft in quick mode: an alias or a full model id.

quickEffort.title: Quick effort
quickEffort.description: How hard the quick rewriter thinks: low, medium, high, xhigh or max.
